events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock's Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years since the mud, music, and peace. What's your favourite memory or track from Woodstock '69?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: On this day in 1977, the music world lost the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who passed away on this day in '77. His music and legend live on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on this day in 1970, leaving behind an unparalleled musical legacy.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Influence
angles.copy: 56 years since we lost a true guitar innovator. Jimi Hendrix's sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969, featuring tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Here Comes the Sun'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: A masterpiece turns 57! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day in '69. Still sounds incredible.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! A true rock legend.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam G
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971, becoming a global message of peace.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon gave us 'Imagine.' Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the groundbreaking first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember this? 25 years ago, the first iPod changed everything. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British secret agent and the film series.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite Bond and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune? Let us know!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. A true visionary whose music still moves us.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! A titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Dive into the White Album
angles.copy: The iconic 'White Album' dropped 58 years ago today. So much to unpack on this legendary Beatles record!

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day in 1991, the world lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury, lead singer of Queen.

angles.name: Tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.
